core_thesis.market_pain: 创作者在 Instagram、TikTok、X 等平台只能放一个链接，Linktree 免费版功能阉割、付费版涨价且页面千人一面；机构和多账号运营者需要多页面、自定义域名和数据统计，官方工具给的自由度不够。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 同一件事做得更好看、更便宜：Starter 5 美元压 Linktree 6 美元一头，Pro 12 美元卖自定义域名和多页面管理，靠页面底部的品牌徽章在每个用户页面上免费获客。复制者不要做通用版，选一个垂直人群（如音乐人、房产经纪、健身教练）预装行业模板和变现组件。

deep_dive.opportunity: Creators get one bio link per platform, while the category leader charges more for plain templates. A cheaper, better-looking page with custom domains and multi-page management wins switchers, and every published page carries a badge that recruits the next user. Copycats should serve one vertical with prebuilt templates.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: The category is crowded and the leader has a huge free base, so generic clones will not grow. Paid search gets expensive; rely on badges, SEO and community launches. Keep churn visible and price below the leader.
workflow: Phase 01: Pick one creator vertical and map its five must-have page blocks before designing anything.
Phase 02: Ship a mobile-first page builder with links, embeds, forms and analytics in two weeks.
Phase 03: Charge from day one: a low starter tier undercutting the leader and a pro tier with custom domains and multi-page plans.
Phase 04: Grow with page badges, comparison SEO pages and one community launch; add search ads only after conversion is proven.

en.summary: A link-in-bio page builder that undercuts Linktree at $5/month with better design, custom domains and multi-page management on the $12 Pro plan; verified at $31.6K MRR as a solo business.
en.title: Link-in-Bio SaaS: Undercut the Leader, Win One Creator Vertical
en.verdict: Verified solo-founder numbers in a crowded market; copycats must niche down to one creator vertical instead of building another generic clone.

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $1,000 ~ $4,000 / 月（复制者稳态，垂直人群口径）

pitfalls_to_avoid: 赛道极度拥挤、龙头有海量免费用户，通用克隆活不下来，必须先锁垂直人群；广告获客成本高，先用徽章裂变和对比页 SEO 验证转化再投钱；免费层只做页面预览、正式发布必须付费，否则垃圾页面和滥用会拖垮口碑。
summary: 给创作者做个人主页链接聚合页：Starter 5 美元/月压 Linktree 一头，Pro 12 美元卖自定义域名和多页面管理；TrustMRR 验证 MRR 31654 美元、5534 个订阅、累计收入 180 万美元，单人运营。复制者切垂直人群，务实目标月入 1000-4000 美元。

workflow_steps.deliverable: 垂直人群页面模板清单
workflow_steps.detail: 选一类创作者（如独立音乐人），列出其页面必备的 5 个模块：作品试听、演出日程、周边商店、邮件订阅、联系方式。模板即卖点。
workflow_steps.title: 锁定垂直人群与模板

workflow_steps.deliverable: 移动优先的页面搭建器 MVP
workflow_steps.detail: 链接块、图片/视频嵌入、表单、点击统计四件套先行；页面打开速度和移动端排版是核心体验，编辑器越简单越好。
workflow_steps.title: 页面搭建器 MVP

workflow_steps.deliverable: 付费发布与多页面套餐闭环
workflow_steps.detail: 预览免费、发布付费；Starter 5 美元单页面，Pro 12 美元起卖自定义域名与多页面（机构客户可叠到每月上百美元）。年付给两个月优惠锁定现金流。
workflow_steps.title: 订阅分层与付费墙

workflow_steps.deliverable: 徽章裂变与对比页流量
workflow_steps.detail: 每个已发布页面底部放品牌徽章导流回官网；做 vs Linktree 对比 SEO 页承接搜索流量；Product Hunt 和垂直社区发一次冷启，广告只在转化跑通后小额测试。
workflow_steps.title: 徽章裂变 + 对比 SEO
